dedupe_keys.name: data for growing imbalance between supply and demand for flood regulation service in the asian water tower and its downstream region

description: Lei Li at Beijing Normal University publishes boundaries and derived flood-regulation indicators for the Asian Water Tower and downstream basins. The free Zenodo ZIP is licensed CC BY 4.0. It contains Shapefile boundaries, GeoTIFF patterns for the 1990 supply-demand ratio, historical trends over 1990–2020, projected trends over 2020–2050 and an Excel table supporting article figures. Annual and seasonal variants are identified. These layers can compare ecosystem-regulation assumptions in basin-scale flood-adaptation scenarios affecting infrastructure exposure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. The ratio is a model-derived service indicator, not a flood-depth or asset-damage map. Scenario definitions, raster resolution, units and uncertainty are not fully established by the repository metadata. Converting these trends into engineering design loads needs additional hydrological evidence. No archive was downloaded or historical and projected results independently recalculated.
